# String Slices and &str
A string slice is a reference to a contiguous sequence of UTF-8 encoded bytes in a `String`.

```rust
fn main() {
    let s = String::from("Boring Rust");

    let first_word = &s[0..6];
    let second_word = &s[7..11];

    println!("First: {}, Second: {}", first_word, second_word);
}
```

### `String` vs `&str`

- `String`: Owned, heap-allocated, resizable buffer.
- `&str`: An immutable view into string data located on the heap, stack, or embedded in the read-only data segment of the binary (string literals).
